name: Goblin Invaders
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The goblin-run Venture Company moved into the Stonetalon Mountains, chopping down trees and burning huge stretches of forest.  The spirits of this place are nearly blind with pain and rage.  We must stop the Venture Company!

Head northwest, beyond the Greatwood Vale and into the Windshear Crag.  You will find the goblins and their servants at work--show them the Horde will not allow the exploitation of Stonetalon.  Show them in the language they best understand...

Violence.
narrative.objectives: Kill 15 Venture Co. Loggers, then return to Seereth Stonebreak on the border of Stonetalon and the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Bravely done, adventurer.

We may ultimately need the wisdom of tauren elders to calm the spirits of Stonetalon, but...

Ridding the Venture Company of its personnel is a good first move against them.
narrative.requestItemsText: The Greatwood Vale lies to the northwest, adventurer. Go. Strike fear into those who would pillage this land!

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 18 to 23, 11,215 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Kill 15 Venture Co. Loggers, then return to Seereth Stonebreak on the border of Stonetalon and the Barrens.

quests.name: The Elder Crone
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Magatha in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Shredding Machines
quests.objectiveText: Kill the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, then return to Seereth Stonebreak at the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens.

quests.name: Return to Thunder Bluff

quests.name: The Flying Machine Airport
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Toxic Fogger to the Venture Co.
